objective: measure eight disjoint random flower-image cohorts and obtain a publication-ready environmental or pollinator concordance result after retaining the underpowered geographic branch as not_evaluable

geographic_shared_boundary.reason: null false-positive rate passed at 0.04, but effect-2 shared-boundary power was 0.21 and heterogeneous-boundary false sharing was 0.16

dependency_correction.scope: prospective v3 only; v2 and its STOP result remain immutable
dependency_correction.reason: the v2 signal-recovery gate qualifies the shared-geographic-concentration statistic, whereas the independently qualified overlay null governs environmental and pollinator concordance
scaleout_pixel_opening_requires: independent Oxford-17 ROI benchmark passes without retuning
metadata feasibility supplies the complete frozen eight-cohort denominator
measurement firewall is built before acquisition
environmental_colour_join_requires: all environmental layers frozen before the sealed coordinate-colour join
pollinator_colour_join_requires: all environmental branch outcomes already fixed and reported
the frozen Bombus coverage and stability gates pass before colour join

scaleout_measurement_gate.coordinate_firewall: an acquisition broker uses the sealed ledger to save every licensed image as measurement_id.jpg; measurement workers receive measurement_id, species_blind_id, the renamed image object and licence only, with no source URL, photo or observation ID, attribution, coordinates, dates, observers, environments or taxon names
scaleout_measurement_gate.failed_species_rule: retain as not_evaluable with its frozen observation denominator; never replace it
scaleout_measurement_gate.failed_cohort_rule: retain the completed cohort and make atlas-wide overlay inference not_evaluable; never stop early or select passing cohorts

ordered_inference_v3.cohorts: all eight disjoint cohorts analyzed with equal cohort weight; no early stopping or selection
ordered_inference_v3.multiplicity: one nested spatially constrained null with a joint maximum statistic across every evaluable cohort, resolution and predeclared overlay family
ordered_inference_v3.publication_rule: publish the complete supported, not_supported and not_evaluable decision tree without replacing failed species, cohorts or overlays

inherited_without_change_from_v2: immutable 6-species Stage A and B results
34-species literature comparison as method and supplementary evidence
eight disjoint random cohorts of 25 species and 300 observations
continuous flower and background colour vector
environmental overlay families and claim ceilings
species-free map and photo bar with species-conditioned inference
prohibitions: do not rerun or reinterpret the stopped v2 geographic statistic on real atlas colour
do not tune ROI, admission, cohort, scale, environmental or pollinator rules after scaleout pixels open
do not replace failed species, cohorts or geographic realms
do not promote significance from one cohort, scale, season or overlay outside the joint null
do not interpret concordance as adaptation, pollinator perception, visitation, selection or causation
